inputs.embed_recipe: each package's frozen mlpathrec.js: fold-honest coef_fh for engine major >= 6 (data/derived/embed_blend_fh.json), leave-one-year-out / exported recipe before
inputs.input_pipelines: own (each package's frozen mlpathrec.js and learned-rate table)

rules.window: 2021-01-01..2023-12-31 (forward-chained: every weight scoring year Y fit on years < Y)

primary.contrast: v10 predict package minus cmp4 (the honest v4 package exactly as v7 defined it)
primary.rows: decisive 2021-2023 fights with an opener for both packages

rules.integrity: both harness runs: 0 failed fights; the protocol's tests passed on the frozen files before the protocol commit
rules.verdict: PASS iff primary AND co-primary AND integrity; nothing else gates
rules.bootstrap: 20,000 event-cluster resamples (card = event + date), seed 7; Monte Carlo SE of each bound (10 batches); a bound within 2 MC SE of its threshold is marginal and decided by the clustered normal bound (tools/predict_score.py check_upper)
descriptive_only: Brier, accuracy, ECE, slope, 7-bin, method, joint, round given a finish, method given the winner, P(decision)
package with props vs cmp4 and vs v10 without props
package leave-one-out: -props, -simulator (v4 cells), -S2 (S / SM cells), -winner (MoE stack)
who x how x when vs methodround model S

package_leave_one_out.note: v10 minus the package with one part replaced (props off in both); negative = the part helps

engine_leave_one_out.note: arm 'all' minus arm '-x' on 2021-2023; negative = the sub-part helps
